items.title: 33.8 Aaloodgi aur bachat ke qawaid-o-zawabit (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.8 (PDF 259); laws as printed, flagged for review.

blocks.text: Hukoomat-e-Punjab ne apne ilaqe (jurisdiction) mein pani ki pollution se nimatne ke liye kai acts aur qawaneen banaye hain. Punjab Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Punjab tamam mutalliqa logon aur idaron (stakeholders) ke liye ba-qaida rules aur regulations jari karti hai. Neeche table mein EPA Punjab ke pani ki pollution par qaboo aur pani bachane se mutalliq ahem qawaneen ka khulasa hai.

blocks.caption: Table 33.3 Mahol ke ahem qawaneen aur pani bachane ke iqdamat
rows: Rs 5 million tak jurmana, aur saath rozana Rs 100,000 tak izafi jurmana.
Pani mein pollutants daalne ya pani ka bahao rokne ki mumaniat.
3 mahine tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmana.
Punjab Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act, 2023
Pani ke istemal aur nikasi (drainage) ki fees muqarrar karta hai; industry aur kheti ki pollution rokne ke liye discharge permits ko control karta hai.
Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025
Bare shehron (Lahore, Multan waghera) mein Authority qaim karta hai jo pani ke wasail ka mukammal intezam aur zameen ke neeche ke pani ki hifazat karti hai.

blocks.title: Maujooda qanoon dekhein
blocks.text: Acts, sazayein aur Did You Know ka jurmana waise hi diye gaye hain jaise kitab mein chhape hain; inhein aaj ke qawaneen se check nahi kiya gaya. Qawaneen aur jurmane badalte rehte hain; taaza maloomat ke liye EPA Punjab aur sarkari gazette dekhein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Pakistan Penal Code ke tehat gari dhone ke liye pipe (hosepipe) istemal karne aur gharon ke lawn ya baghon mein khula pani chhorne (flood irrigation) par Rs 10,000 jurmana hai.

blocks.prompt: Punjab ka kaun sa act pani mein pollutants daalne ya pani ka bahao rokne se mana karta hai, aur kitab us ki kya saza batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Punjab Water Act, 2019; saza 3 mahine tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmana.

items: EPA Punjab pani ki pollution par rules aur regulations jari karti hai.
Acts: Environmental Protection Act 1997, Water Act 2019, Irrigation, Drainage and Rivers Act 2023, Water and Sanitation Authority Act 2025.
